correctness.rationale: For each prime-power block \(q=p^a\), one has \(\psi(q)-\Psi(q)=\Phi(q)-\varphi(q)=p^{a-1}-1\). The exact coprime-block recurrence for the first gap is a sum of nonnegative terms and becomes strict precisely when a nonsquarefree block coexists with another prime support. The second gap satisfies \(H(mq)=qH(m)+\Psi(m)-\Phi(m)\), forcing strictness after a second support. The product equality is factorwise, with local gap \(p^{2a-2}-1\). These arguments establish all quantifiers without finite assumptions; the verifier through \(n=50000\) is regression evidence only.

value.rationale: The focal paper establishes three inequalities but leaves their sharpness sets unspecified. The complete equality classification exposes a clean structural trichotomy: the mixed gap vanishes exactly on prime powers or squarefree integers, the modified-sum inequality is sharp exactly on prime powers, and the modified-product inequality is sharp exactly on squarefree integers. These are canonical multiplicative classes, so the theorem is a natural structural completion rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
